title: HWASan 与 Android 整机内存错误定位
key_conclusions: HWASan detects memory errors by comparing pointer tags with memory tags, making tag mismatch the central report concept.
Compared with ASan redzones, HWASan is especially useful for Android 64-bit UAF and stale pointer scenarios where memory may be reused quickly.
HWASan diagnosis still needs the same engineering discipline as ASan: preserve symbols, ABI, build variant, raw logs, and reproducible steps.
When HWASan cannot be enabled, the blocker must be recorded and the workflow should fall back to ASan, GWP-ASan, Scudo, or malloc_debug depending on scope.
shallow_points: The article does not include a real HWASan tag mismatch report from an Android device or system image.
It does not validate concrete HWASan build flags or system image setup across Android versions, NDK releases, and ROMs.
It does not include runnable samples comparing ASan redzone reports with HWASan tag mismatch reports for the same bug.
It does not quantify runtime overhead or coverage differences on a target device.
